subtasks.description: Declare the 7‑bit CRC register and any supporting combinational wires (e.g., for inv) according to the interface and clock/reset specifications.
constraints: CRC register width must be exactly 7 bits and reset asynchronously to 0 as described in S004.
Port/interface signals (BITVAL, Enable, CLK, RST, CRC) must faithfully implement the declarations in S002.

subtasks.description: Combinationally compute inv = BITVAL ^ CRC[6] using a continuous assignment or combinational always block.
constraints: Logic must be purely combinational – no registers, no sequential elements.
Directly wire inv as the XOR of BITVAL and CRC[6].

subtasks.description: Implement the sequential CRC update: on rising CLK, asynchronous RST resets CRC to 0; else if Enable is high, shift CRC with CRC[0]<=inv, CRC[3]<=CRC[2]^inv, oth bits CRC[i]<=CRC[i-1]; if Enable low, hold CRC. Precedence of reset and hold behavior per spec.
constraints: Async reset (RST) must override Enable and immediately force CRC to 0; shift‑XOR update equations must exactly match S005, with hold when Enable deasserted.
Use a single sequential always block; no extra pipeline or clocked stages.
Output CRC directly from the register.
